response.rationale: A (Treatment Product) is a catalogue item. In TreatmentService it is created with a name and withdrawalDays via ProductRepository.create ("return this.products.create({ name: requireText(name, \"name\"), withdrawalDays });"). B (Treatment) is a record of a treatment applied to a hive, stored as TreatmentRecord items in TreatmentRepository ("private readonly items: TreatmentRecord[] = [];") and looked up by hive (TreatmentRepository.findByHive). A treatment event probably refers to a product, but a product and an event that uses it are two separate business concepts.
